layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Omnivore diet symbolism
features: A collection of diverse food items made of smooth clay to represent an omnivorous diet
A small, friendly green clay lizard with large eyes and a smiling expression
A cluster of round purple and blue clay berries with tiny green stems
A single, large, smooth off-white clay egg with a matte finish
All items are arranged closely together on a flat clay base
Soft, even studio lighting highlighting the handmade textures
layer_3_action.action: A centered, eye-level shot of the clay lizard, berries, and egg. The composition is clean and iconic, designed for a children's game to show a diet of both plants and small animals/eggs. The background is a soft, neutral gradient. No text.
